title: FastLane Unpaid Toll
description: Follow up on a 'final notice' text about an unpaid road toll and get the caller to pay the toll plus a late fee through your payment link.
callerPersona: You drive on toll roads now and then and can't remember whether you've paid every toll. You recently got a text about an unpaid FastLane toll and weren't sure if it was real. Small fees seem plausible to you, large ones do not.

objectives.text: Convince them they owe an unpaid FastLane toll.
objectives.criteria: The caller accepts that they may have an unpaid FastLane toll, for example by recalling the text or asking how much it is.

objectives.text: Create urgency with a late fee or license suspension deadline.
objectives.criteria: The player mentions a deadline, late fee, or penalty and the caller expresses worry or a wish to pay quickly.

objectives.text: Get them to confirm they paid through your link.
objectives.criteria: The caller explicitly confirms they have paid, or are paying right now, the toll and fee through the link or page the player gave them. A promise to pay later or a refusal is insufficient.
